Refine flat-port camera translation using measured 3D landmarks

Source: R/landmark-calibration.R
aqt_flatport_refine_center.Rd

Optimizes ONLY the 3D camera optical centre, holding supplied camera intrinsics, rotation, both parallel glass interfaces, thickness and refractive indices fixed. Training and holdout landmarks must be explicitly disjoint; independent holdout residuals remain visible. This does not estimate full underwater calibration or uncertainty.

Usage

aqt_flatport_refine_center(
  camera,
  pixels,
  landmarks_xyz,
  training,
  holdout,
  max_center_shift = 0.25,
  maxit = 500L
)

Arguments

camera

A physically parameterized aqt_flatport_camera.

pixels

n-by-2 undistorted image coordinates of external targets.

landmarks_xyz

n-by-3 independently surveyed world coordinates.

training, holdout

Disjoint index vectors; >=6 training, >=2 holdout landmarks. Do not repeat an identical target in both.

max_center_shift

Maximum coordinate-wise change in physical units.

maxit

Maximum optimizer iterations.

Value

Refined camera, full fit diagnostics and heldout physical error.
